<b>Druid's Eye</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It regenerates [[Silk]] as damage is taken. It can be upgraded into Druid's Eyes, strengthening its effects.

== Usefulness ==
When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] equips the Druid's Eye, as long as the Silk Spool is not full, taking one hit will add a green blob to the Silk Spool, and a second hit transforms the blob into a full strand of Silk. Damage sources that deal {{Damage|1+1}} will count as two hits, activating the tool twice, however those that deal {{Damage|2}} only counts as one hit and the tool will only be activated once. When upgraded into Druid's Eyes, two blobs are generated with each hit and transform into two strands instead.

Green blobs always disappear when the Silk Spool is full, although the blobs themselves are not counted for this. This means that Druid's Eyes can produce blobs which exceed Hornet's Silk capacity, when Hornet is hit while one Silk away from maximum capacity. Taking another hit will grant as much Silk as possible without exceeding Hornet's Silk capacity.

Green blobs are not preserved when quitting the game. They will also disappear when Craft Binding with the [[Architect Crest]]. These blobs can stack side-by-side with the white blobs generated by the [[Reaper Crest]], but they do not combine into strands of Silk together.

| Image1 = Silk Spool with Druid's Eye.png!Silk Spool when Druid's Eye is ready to regenerate a strand
| Image2 = DruidsEyesGreenSilk.png!Silk Spool when Druid's Eyes is ready to regenerate two strands
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Moss Druid]] after completing the <i>[[Berry Picking]]</i> Wish.

Bring 4 additional [[Mossberries]] to Moss Druid after completing the Berry Picking wish (for a total of 7 Mossberries) to upgrade the Druid's Eye into Druid's Eyes.

== Trivia ==
* Any additional silk past the first spool (9 silk) will be smaller. However, if Hornet has 8 silk and 2 green blobs, then takes damage, both will transform into full sized silk threads. The thread returns to its appropriate size as soon as Hornet's current silk changes.
